name: Metal nut defect localisation
rationale: Showing the operator where the defect is on the part makes the reject decision fast and auditable.
framing: Object detection: boxes around every defect region in a top-camera image; no box means a good part.
target_definition: one 'defect' box per connected region of the QC inspection's defect mask; none for good parts
split_strategy: random 60/20/20, stratified by defect type (one image per physical part)
